_description: Bid-Ask strategy preset — catches deep dips with edge-concentrated liquidity. Wider range, longer hold, looser SL. Best for sideways markets with whipsaws or when expecting buy-the-dip opportunities. Less frequent trades (~5-10/day vs spot ~25-50/day), longer compounding cycle.

_strategy_overview.spot: uniform liquidity across bins below active (current default — high frequency, tight exits)
_strategy_overview.bid_ask: concentrated at FARTHEST bin = deepest below active (this preset — catch deep dumps, ride rebound)
_strategy_overview.curve: concentrated near active (not in this preset — quick fills, similar to spot)
